timeline.text: are yall open thursday the 19th in the afternoon? need an oil change

Hi! On Thursday the 19th all three Brennan Auto Care shops close at noon for our twice-a-year inventory count, so there's no afternoon service that day. That morning we're open from 7:30, and every other weekday it's the usual 7:30 to 5:30. Would you like me to ask the shop to set up a morning time for you?
nah mornings dont work. ill just come friday. thx
Sounds good. Fridays are regular hours, 7:30 to 5:30. Have a good one!
